title: Senior Frontend Developer (Angular) - Remote (EU)
description:
ViaBill operates at the intersection of the eCommerce, payments and consumer credit sectors, and is an industry pioneer and early market entrant in the BNPL industry, which is experiencing rapid growth. Becoming the best at something isn’t easy. It takes skill, hard work, and an unmatched level of ambition and determination. Our team is international, experienced and most of all, hardworking. In just a few years, we’ve grown from our first office in an art gallery in Denmark to having our teams located all over the globe.
From a handful of customers to handling transactions worth more than $150M per year, we aren’t afraid of new challenges and new markets. Our strategy has been validated with external investment from leading VC’s Headline and BlackFin Capital Partners.
We’re hiring a Senior Frontend Developer to join our product engineering team.
Fully remote, open to candidates based anywhere in the EU.
You’ll build merchant-facing and consumer-facing products in Angular with NgRx , shipping features that directly affect how people pay and how merchants grow. What you’ll work on

∙ Angular 20+ applications with full NgRx state management (actions, reducers, selectors, effects)
∙ Merchant portals, checkout flows, and consumer-facing product UIs
∙ TypeScript in strict mode, component testing with Jest, responsive mobile-first design
∙ Collaborating closely with designers, backend engineers, and product in a squad-based setup (Spotify model)

∙ Beyond frontend development, you are comfortable owning Node.js/ExpressJS services . These are not just bridges for the UI, but standalone microservices that require proactive development, maintenance, and debugging.

What we expect

∙ Strong Angular and TypeScript - not framework tourism, but real depth
∙ Solid grasp of reactive state management (NgRx or equivalent)
∙ You write tests. Not as an afterthought - as part of how you ship
∙ You use AI tools (Claude Code, etc.) as a multiplier, not a crutch. You direct, critique, and own the output
∙ You make architectural trade-offs consciously and can explain them plainly

What matters most to us

∙ Clean, pragmatic code over pixel-perfect portfolios

∙ How you think and solve problems over years of experience

∙ Your ability to build and deliver over formal certifications

How we hire
You’ll complete a focused take-home challenge (2-3 hours, realistic scope).

You build a small app using Angular + NgRx + a public API.

We evaluate functional completeness, code quality, architectural decisions, and how you collaborate with AI tools - including a written log of your AI interactions and the judgement calls you made.
Then we talk through it. You should be able to explain every line.

Stack : Angular 20+, NgRx, TypeScript (strict), Jest, Node.js/ExpressJS services, CSS framework of your choice

Location : Fully remote - EU residents only

About our team:

We’re a highly motivated, fully remote team of developers who thrive on collaboration and innovation. Our workflow is inspired by open-source principles , with core maintainers for our services and a flat hierarchy that gives each developer the freedom to own their work .

Seamless collaboration - We keep things efficient with direct access to domain experts via Slack or Meet, ensuring quick decision-making.

Rapid release cycle - We ship multiple times per day, creating a fast feedback loop that keeps us motivated and allows us to see our impact on the business in real time.

Innovation-driven - Our streamlined processes make it easy to experiment, iterate, and adopt new trends & frameworks quickly.

If you enjoy autonomy, impact, and working with cutting-edge technology, you’ll fit right in!

title: Senior Back-End Software Engineer
description:
About VFX
VFX Financial is one of the UK’s fastest-growing FinTechs, helping complex organisations move, manage, and protect money across borders. Built for specialist sectors, multi-jurisdiction structures, and high-compliance environments, we support businesses whose needs go beyond standard banking. We’re selective about who we work with because exceptional service requires focus and commitment.
With six international offices, five regulatory licences, and an 83% CAGR over the past three years, we’re scaling rapidly and earning industry recognition along the way - including the Financial Times FT1000: Europe’s Fastest Growing Companies 2026, CNBC UK’s Top Fintech Companies 2025, Wealth & Finance FinTech Awards 2026, and the Business Growth Award from Business Awards UK.

Behind it all is a team of ambitious VFXers united by collective ownership, a focus on growth, and a shared passion for solving complex problems.

About the Role
We’re seeking a highly capable and technically strong Back-End Software Engineer to lead the design and delivery of core systems powering VFX’s global financial infrastructure. You will operate across complex, high-value domains including multi-currency account architecture, payment routing, treasury operations, risk management, compliance workflows, and API-driven client integrations.
This role combines hands-on engineering with technical leadership. You will be responsible for shaping architecture, guiding development standards, and leading a team of engineers while remaining actively involved in building scalable, secure, and resilient systems. You will work within a cloud-native environment (Azure), driving best practices across CI/CD, system design, and engineering discipline.
This role is suited to someone who brings strong technical ownership, leadership capability, and a pragmatic mindset. You will thrive if you enjoy building high-performance systems while elevating the quality and capability of the team around you.
This role can be hybrid at our office in Portimao or fully remote across Portugal.
Key Responsibilities

• Lead the design, development, and deployment of robust .NET applications within a cloud-based Azure environment.

• Define and implement scalable system architecture, ensuring performance, reliability, and maintainability across services.

• Drive CI/CD best practices, including the implementation and optimisation of pipelines using GitHub Actions.

• Collaborate closely with Product, Operations, and Engineering teams to translate complex business requirements into effective technical solutions.

• Mentor and support engineers within the team, providing technical guidance, code reviews, and fostering continuous development.

• Establish and uphold engineering standards across coding practices, security, performance optimisation, and system design.

• Actively participate in and lead code reviews, ensuring high-quality, maintainable, and consistent outputs.

• Contribute to Agile delivery processes, using tools such as Jira to track progress, manage priorities, and improve delivery predictability.

• Drive adoption of modern technologies, patterns, and approaches that enhance engineering efficiency and platform capability.

• Support incident resolution, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement of system stability and resilience.

Key Challenges

• Leading the delivery of enterprise-grade systems within a regulated financial services environment.

• Balancing hands-on development with leadership, mentoring, and architectural responsibilities.

• Ensuring consistency and quality across a growing engineering team.

• Translating complex financial and operational requirements into scalable technical solutions.

• Driving engineering standards while maintaining delivery velocity.

• Managing technical decision-making across evolving systems and priorities.

Candidate Profile

• Strong technical leader who leads by example through hands-on engineering and high standards.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Go/Ruby) – Gateways & Enterprise AI Infrastructure
description:
About Workato

Workato delivers enterprise infrastructure for the agentic era, redefining iPaaS and helping enterprises unify data, applications, processes, and AI into a single, governed platform. A leader in Enterprise MCP and trusted by 50% of the Fortune 500, Workato’s cloud-native architecture connects every application, data source, and process to power real-time orchestration at scale. With enterprise-grade security and continuous innovation at its core, Workato provides the trusted foundation for organizations to automate with confidence and operationalize AI across the business. To learn more, visit www.workato.com

Why join us?

Ultimately, Workato believes in fostering a flexible, trust-oriented culture that empowers everyone to take full ownership of their roles . We are driven by innovation and looking for team players who want to actively build our company. 

But, we also believe in balancing productivity with self-care . That’s why we offer all of our employees a vibrant and dynamic work environment along with a multitude of benefits they can enjoy inside and outside of their work lives. 

If this sounds right up your alley, please submit an application. We look forward to getting to know you!

Also, feel free to check out why:

•
Business Insider named us an “enterprise startup to bet your career on”

•
Forbes’ Cloud 100 recognized us as one of the top 100 private cloud companies in the world

•
Deloitte Tech Fast 500 ranked us as the 17th fastest growing tech company in the Bay Area, and 96th in North America

•
Quartz ranked us the #1 best company for remote workers

Responsibilities

We're building the infrastructure layer that connects enterprise systems to AI: an MCP Gateway , an AI Gateway , and the services around them. These are the systems that sit between LLM providers and everything else - routing, auth, rate limiting, observability, protocol translation. We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Go/Ruby) - Gateways & Enterprise AI Infrastructure who understands both the systems layer and the AI protocol layer, and who can build production-grade services in Go and/or Ruby.

In this role, you will also be responsible to:

•
Design and develop the MCP Gateway and AI Gateway - production services that mediate between applications, AI agents, and LLM providers. This means protocol-level work: MCP server/client implementations, request routing, streaming, tool-call proxying, authn/authz, and tenant isolation. You'll build the core infrastructure, not just applications on top of it.

•
Build high-throughput, low-latency network services. You'll work close to the wire: TCP, TLS, HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2, JSON streaming, connection pooling, backpressure. When latency matters, you'll know exactly where it goes.

•
Own the data layer from the application side. Deep PostgreSQL knowledge - schema design, indexing strategies, query planning, transactions and isolation levels, connection management. You're not a DBA, but you can read EXPLAIN ANALYZE output and fix the query, not just add an index and hope.

•
Design for concurrency. Worker pools, queues, graceful shutdown, backpressure, race-free shared state. You can profile a service under load (pprof, flamegraphs, query stats), find the bottleneck, and fix it.

•
Drive observability for AI systems. Metrics, tracing, and logging that actually tell you what's happening - token usage, latency per provider, cache hit rates, failure modes, cost per request.

How We Work with AI

•
We encourage - but never force - the use of AI/LLM tools in development. If AI-assisted workflows make you faster, use them heavily. If you prefer to write something by hand, that's equally respected. What we care about is the quality of what ships, not how it was typed.

•

As a Red Team Engineer, you are the adversary to our own systems. Because our systems span domains - space, missiles, air, autonomy, sensors - you are expected to reason across all of them and follow a problem wherever it leads. description:
The Opportunity
FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to lead Reclaim, an AI-native denial management and revenue recovery venture. This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.
We are entering a $16B+ Total Addressable Market with a gaping $ 7.5B-$10B whitespace, targeting the highly underserved mid-market segment. Currently, 30-40% of denied medical claims go uncontested because practices lack the staff and capital to contest them. This systemic failure leaves between $50,000 and $300,000 in legally earned revenue permanently abandoned at each practice every year.
Reclaim AI resolves denied and aged claims end-to-end, embedding outcome-based contingency pricing-meaning practices pay zero upfront, and we only take a cut of the dollars we successfully recover, for our target ideal customer profile (practices with $80K+ in annual recoverable claims).
Market Context
We didn’t just read market reports; we spent weeks interviewing billing managers, practice owners, revenue cycle leaders at health systems, and even digital operations leaders at major insurance companies. The dysfunction we uncovered is staggering, creating a massive opportunity for a disruptor:

• The pain is so severe, practices are building their own tech: The frustration of payer opacity is so deep that medical billers are hiring part-time software engineers to build in-house robotic process automation (RPA) scrapers just to check claim statuses.

• Massive, emotional write-offs: Staff carry immense guilt over these administrative losses. One small-practice assistant admitted, "I feel like we probably had to write off probably close to a million dollars" simply because they couldn't keep up with the manual follow-ups.

• The "Payer-Side Inversion" Opportunity: We discovered that insurance companies are drowning in the exact same claims dysfunction they generate. One major payer we interviewed reported a backlog of 31,000 contested claims that consumed 80% of their staff's operational capacity, forcing emergency hires just to manage the disputes.

• The Competition is Distracted: Well-funded Tier-1 competitors are charging $15K+ upfront licensing fees and fighting over enterprise health systems. The competitive window to capture the mid-market with a contingency-priced autonomous agent is wide open.

The Partnership

• Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception

• Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one

• Investor and advisor network across vertical AI and early-stage capital markets

title: Startup Design Accelerator
description:
About the Program:

Every year, we sponsor 2 remote design accelerator apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our design apprentices work through the end-to-end digital design and research process for a startup idea of their choice.

Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and build an idea they are passionate about!

Apprenticeship Requirements:

This apprenticeship program is open to business owners, startup founders, new grads and career changers looking for creative outlets! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:

• Interested in entrepreneurship, building a digital app, AI app, or digital startup idea

• Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables

• Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules

• Open to feedback from mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work

Apprenticeship Program Learnings:

• Build digital products and services 0-1

• Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice

• Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management

• Identify target market for product and position product for launch success

• Incorporate AI tools into your UX design process

• Design AI features and products by considering AI specific design parameters and heuristics

• Understand how AI works and advocate for ethical AI design that builds trust without over-reliance with users

• Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales

• Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights

• Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution

• Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables

• Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea

• Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution

• Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options

• Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.

How to Apply:

Please fill out our application form to apply for UX Woman sponsoring your participation in the program. The application takes 5 minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your LinkedIn profile and resume, as well as ask you about why you are interested in this program. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply - we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.

You will receive UX and business tips and challenges via email and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status. title: Cash Accounting Allocation Specialist
description:
The Role

At HelloConnect, you will be part of a dynamic team in Inoza tower, BGC that embraces innovation and leverages advanced technology to create exceptional experiences. Our culture is built on collaboration, continuous learning, and a commitment to excellence. You’ll have the opportunity to work on impactful projects, develop your skills, and grow within a supportive environment that values diverse perspectives and experiences.

In this role, you will take on a key responsibility for accurately matching and allocating incoming payments to invoices in SAP S/4HANA, maintaining cash-ledger integrity, performing bank statement processing and reconciliations, and resolving unapplied or short-payments. This role is pivotal for working capital accuracy and timely clearing of open items, contributing to our ongoing efforts to drive business success and enhance customer satisfaction.

We’re looking for passionate individuals who can bring their unique skills and ideas to the table. Even if you don't meet every requirement but believe you’d excel in this role, we’d love to hear from you!

What you’ll do

• Process incoming bank statements and electronic payment files; post and clear customer/vendor payments and allocate receipts to the correct open items in SAP S/4HANA.

• Execute automated and manual cash application routines; investigate and resolve unmatched items, short pays, unapplied receipts, and suspense account postings.

• Maintain the cash-clearing process for both vendor payments (where applicable) and customer receipts; ensure GL and subledger reconciliations.

• Liaise with Treasury and Payments teams to reconcile payment advice, investigate payment file anomalies, and support payment investigations.

• Work with AP/AR teams, business owners and vendors to obtain remittance details and resolve allocation issues.

• Prepare weekly/monthly bank reconciliations, including reconciliation of house banks, clearing accounts, and suspense accounts.

• Support month-end close activities related to cash and bank accounts and prepare supporting schedules and variance explanations.

• Implement and improve automated matching rules, bank statement rules, and exception-handling workflows in SAP/Fiori.

Day-to-day tasks:

• Review automated match results and process exceptions from the cash application queue.

• Post manual allocations and clearing entries in SAP when automated matching fails.

• Investigate differences (amount, reference, currency) and clear items or move to suspense with clear notes for follow-up.

• Reconcile bank statement items to GL and open item reports; liaise with bank/treasury for outstanding items.

• Record and monitor short payments, refunds, and chargebacks and route for resolution.

Systems & Tools:

• SAP S/4HANA (Fiori) - Bank Statement Posting, Cash Application/clearing apps

• OpenText (if vendor/payment advices are stored in inbound archive)

• Bank portals and electronic banking interfaces (EBICS, SWIFT, or local equivalents) - familiarity helpful

• Excel (advanced), Power Query, and/or SQL for ad-hoc analyses

• Treasury management systems knowledge is a plus

What you’ll bring

• 3+ years experience in cash application, bank reconciliations, or cash accounting in an ERP environment.

• Practical experience with SAP S/4HANA bank statement processing, clearing, and open-item accounting.

• Strong problem-solving skills, exceptional attention to detail and an organized approach to managing exceptions.

• Proficiency with Excel for reconciliations and reporting.

• Clear communicator and collaborator with internal stakeholders (treasury, AR/AP, business units) and external banks

What we offer

• Competitive Compensation : Beyond the standard package, we offer perks like Long Service Benefits (anniversary bonus) to recognize and celebrate your dedication

• Wellness & Perks : We prioritize your well-being by offering mental health support, HMO medical coverage, generous leave benefits p

PREFECT https://www.prefect.io/ BUILDS AND OPERATES RESILIENT, PYTHONIC ORCHESTRATION AND MCP PLATFORMS -- PREFECT OSS https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect, PREFECT CLOUD https://www.prefect.io/prefect/cloud, FASTMCP OSS, https://gofastmcp.com/getting-started/welcome AND HORIZON https://www.prefect.io/horizon-- USED FOR MISSION-CRITICAL WORKLOADS.

Our Vision: Prefect will define automation for the context era.

Our Mission: Curate an intelligent context layer that delivers the right information at the right time.

About Prefect

Prefect builds automation for an unpredictable world. The last decade of automation was about protecting workflows from unpredictability; in the agentic era, unpredictability is the point. Our mission is to give people confidence in automated work, whether that work is a mission-critical data pipeline or a fleet of AI agents.

In August 2026, Prefect and Dagster, competitors for eight years, joined forces to build the next generation of automation infrastructure. Today, our ecosystem includes Dagster, the data platform; Prefect, the agent platform; and FastMCP, the leading open-source developer framework for the MCP ecosystem. Together, our open-source and commercial products are trusted by Fortune 500 companies, data innovators, and high-growth technology companies around the world.

We think of our culture as the operating system of the company. We’ve carefully created a supportive, high-performance environment that empowers our team to do the best work of their careers, have meaningful impact, and continue growing personally and professionally. We’re a remote-first team that values high standards, ownership, and thoughtful collaboration.

ROLE SUMMARY

Prefect and Dagster merged in 2026, and we're consolidating two data stacks onto one: Snowflake as the warehouse, Dagster as the orchestrator, dogfooded on our own product. You'll take over our existing internal data platform, land the migrated stack at cutover, and own it end to end from there. You own finding and deciding requirements, setting the roadmap, and working directly with stakeholders across orgs. Part of our platform is open source (dagster-open-platform https://github.com/dagster-io/dagster-open-platform/tree/main) and your work is a public reference implementation of our own product. You’ll report to Jenny, our Head of Engineering.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own the internal data platform end to end: Snowflake architecture, sizing, and cost; dbt transformations; orchestration standards in Dagster

- Own ingestion tooling (Fivetran, Sling, dlt, AWS DMS) and reverse ETL (Hightouch, Census)

- Own warehouse access controls and security - increasingly important as MCPs touch more of our data

- Design the system so teams stop blocking each other: fewer cross-team dependencies, less homegrown ingestion debt, a sane change-data-capture story

- Own platform reliability: Dagster+ alerting, data quality, and cost

- Take on the deferred data backlog: one-off ingestion, enablement, and growth data work

- Partner with engineering on SLA-carrying pipelines (billing, consumption pricing) where engineering retains ownership

- Live in Dagster daily and feed what you learn back to the product team

YOUR QUALIFICATIONS

- Staff-level data platform experience - you set architecture across orgs and work through stakeholders independently

- Deep production experience with dbt and a modern cloud warehouse

- Experience with a modern orchestrator and experience with Dagster is a plus

- Hands-on with managed ingestion and reverse ETL tooling

- Self-directed and able to turn ambiguous business asks into scoped, prioritized work

- Comfortable working in the open on a public codebase

WHAT YOU'LL GET IN RETURN:

- San Francisco Bay Area & NYC Metro: $221,000-$276,000

Fi is leveraging our team's talent and expertise to improve the lives of millions of pets in the U.S. Real-time location tracking, activity, sleep and behavior monitoring - and that's just the beginning.

The most exciting aspect of our work? Bridging the communication gap between pets and humans. Imagine a world where everyone knows how their pet feels in real time and how to keep their best friend in good shape. That's the future we're building at Fi .

If you're someone who thrives in innovative, collaborative work environments and feels strongly about helping pets live longer, better lives, Fi could be the perfect fit. Join us in our pursuit of the “impossible,” or as we call it here “let me find a way,” to redefine the future of pet ownership together.

Fi is looking for a Head of Data! Fi is looking for a Head of Data to own our data platform end to end. You'll model our device, membership, and operational data into the pipelines and warehouse layers the company runs on, lead a team of four analysts, and be the numbers person Fi nance and Product turn to for board reporting, forecasting, and experiment reads. This is a hands-on role for someone who's built a data function before and wants to do it again, this time with real leverage.

What You'll Do:

• Own Fi 's data platform and analytics roadmap: model our device, membership, and operational data into pipelines and warehouse layers the whole company can build on

• Partner with Fi nance on subscription and unit economics: membership forecasting, retention and LTV modeling, hardware margin, and the reporting our board and investors see

• Partner with Product and Hardware on activation, engagement, and device performance analytics - including the sensor and firmware data behind features customers actually feel

• Build self-serve BI that stakeholders genuinely use, rather than a dashboard graveyard

• Shift the data team from a ticket-taking service function into a strategic partner embedded in the business

• Experience leading analysts - formally or as a player-coach - with a real point of view on how to develop them

• Deep SQL, plus hands-on work in a modern warehouse and orchestration stack (Databricks, Snowflake, Spark, Airflow, dbt or similar)

• Fluency in dimensional and event-driven modeling, and clear opinions on ELT tradeoffs, incremental builds, and cost control

• Strong BI craft in Looker, Tableau, Mode, or equivalent - you build for the stakeholder, not the demo

• Comfort partnering with Fi nance on models that carry real consequences: forecasts, diligence materials, margin analysis

• Ability to work in ambiguity at Series B scale, where you'll sometimes be the entire data team for a given problem

Why You'll Love Us:

Capco’s cutting-edge ingenuity is brought to life through its Innovation Labs and award-winning Be Yourself At Work culture and diverse talent.

 

Role Summary

The QA Automation Tester is responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of software solutions through robust testing strategies and automation practices. Acting as a key contributor within the delivery lifecycle, this role focuses on designing and implementing scalable test automation frameworks, leading testing activities, and ensuring alignment with business and technical requirements.

Working across the full Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), the QA Tester operates effectively within Agile/Scrum environments, collaborating with cross-functional teams including developers, product owners, and stakeholders. The role requires sense of ownership, problem-solving, and communication skills to drive quality assurance initiatives and continuous improvement.

 

What You’ll Do

• Design, develop, and maintain test automation frameworks, standards, processes, and best practices

Other Desired Qualifications

• Experience in non-functional testing (e.g. performance, availability)

• Knowledge of tools such as JMeter or similar performance testing tools

• Experience with mobile automation tools such as Espresso and XCUITest

• Familiarity with markup and data formats such as XML

• Ownership and accountability. You take initiative, identify issues early and follow through to delivery.

description:

- Analyse von Märkten, Wettbewerbern und neuen Geschäftsmöglichkeiten

- Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Business-Development- und Wachstumsstrategien

- Identifikation und Bewertung potenzieller Partnerschaften und Marktchancen

- Erstellung von Analysen, Business Cases und Entscheidungsvorlagen

- Analyse und Optimierung von Vertriebs-, CRM- und Pipeline-Prozessen

- Eigenständige Bearbeitung strategischer und operativer Projekte

title: Data Senior Engineer - Data Modernization & Archiving - Remote (Toronto, ON, CA)
description:

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
We are currently seeking a Data Senior Engineer - Data Modernization & Archiving - Remote to join our team in Toronto, Ontario (CA-ON), Canada (CA).
Senior Developer - Data Modernization & Archiving
Project Overview
We are seeking Senior Developers to support a data modernization and archiving initiative involving the migration of historical financial data from a legacy UNISYS mainframe environment to a secure, scalable, and user-friendly archival solution.
The successful candidates will bring strong experience in Microsoft Power BI, Oracle PL/SQL, and ETL development , with a proven ability to work across data analysis, data modelling, migration, business intelligence, reporting, validation, testing, integration, and deployment.
Working closely with business and technical stakeholders, the Senior Developers will help design and implement solutions that meet requirements for data quality, reporting, performance, governance, and long-term data retention .
Key Responsibilities

• Gather, analyze, validate, and translate business and technical requirements into functional and technical specifications.

• Analyze legacy and source-system data and develop data models, mappings, business rules, and data structures .

• Design, develop, and maintain Oracle PL/SQL and ETL processes supporting data migration, transformation, and archival.

• Design, develop, and enhance Microsoft Power BI dashboards, reports, datasets, and visualizations .

• Develop business intelligence and ad-hoc reporting solutions to support business and operational requirements.

• Integrate reporting and data solutions with existing applications, databases, and other data sources.

• Develop data validation, reconciliation, error-handling, and quality assurance processes to ensure data integrity.

• Perform unit testing, data validation, troubleshooting, performance tuning, and defect resolution.

• Support reporting integrations, APIs, embedded analytics, and related data services as required.

title: Senior Direct Editor & Ad Designer
description:
Create Ads That Stop the Scroll and Drive Results

Are you a senior video editor who understands that great advertising is about more than making content look good?

Do you know how to build a strong hook, maintain viewer retention, and turn raw footage into creative that drives conversions?

We are looking for a Senior Video Editor & Ad Designer with strong experience in Direct Response, DTC, and Performance Marketing .

This is not a traditional video editing role. You will be responsible for creating, analysing, and continuously improving high-performing advertising creative. Rather than spending your time on repetitive administrative tasks, you will have the freedom to focus on creative production, testing, research, and performance.

What You'll Do

Create High-Performing Ads

• Produce high-volume video and static ads for Meta and other paid social platforms.

• Transform UGC, raw footage, product B-roll, AI-generated assets, and creative briefs into compelling advertising.

• Develop multiple creative variations to test different hooks, angles, messaging, visuals, and formats.

• Create ads that feel native to the platform while maintaining a high standard of production quality.

Build Strong Hooks and Retention

The first few seconds of an ad are critical. You will create attention-grabbing openings designed to stop the scroll and keep viewers engaged.

Your work will include:

• Strong visual and audio hooks

• Pattern interrupts

• Fast, feed-native pacing

• Punch-ins and dynamic cuts

• Strategic B-roll

• Retention-focused transitions

• Visual and audio techniques that maintain attention

Visual and Sound Design

You will use your editing and motion design skills to strengthen the performance of every creative.

Responsibilities include:

• Dynamic typography and captions

• Motion graphics

• VFX and compositing

• Motion tracking

• Masking and keying

• Product cutouts and screen replacements

• Strategic visual effects

• Sound effects, music, risers, impacts, and transitions

• AI-generated voiceovers and audio

Every creative decision should serve a purpose: attention, retention, or conversion.

Think Like a Performance Marketer

This role requires more than strong editing skills. You should be comfortable using performance data to understand why creative succeeds or fails.

You will analyse metrics such as:

• Hook Rate

• Hold Rate

• Outbound CTR

• CPA

• Retention

• Conversion performance

When an ad underperforms, you should be able to identify the likely creative issue and determine what needs to change.

For example:

• Is the hook too weak?

• Is the pacing too slow?

• Is the message unclear?

• Is the visual failing to capture attention?

• Is the CTA getting lost?

You will use these insights to create stronger iterations and improve performance.

Creative Research and Competitive Analysis

You will regularly research successful advertising creative across:

• Meta Ad Library

• TikTok Creative Center

• YouTube Shorts

• Competitor advertising

• Emerging creative formats and trends

You should be able to identify new hooks, editing styles, formats, pattern interrupts, UGC approaches, and other creative opportunities before they become saturated.

AI-Powered Creative

AI is an important part of the creative workflow. You will use AI tools to increase production speed, creative variety, and testing capacity.

Experience with AI tools for the following is highly valued:

• Video generation

• Image generation

• Voiceovers

• Audio

• Creative research

• Asset creation

• Creative testing

What We're Looking For

Experience

•
5-10+ years of professional video editing or creative experience.

• Strong experience in Direct Response, DTC, e-commerce, paid social, or performance marketing .

• Agency or DTC experience is highly preferred.
Direct-Response Expertise

You understand:

• Consumer psychology

• Hooks and pattern interrupts

• Retention

• Creative angles

• Calls to action

title: SEO Specialist
description:

Your Responsibilities:
Search Growth & Performance

• Own growth in total search clicks and clicks per article, driving the initiatives required to hit targets.

• Build and maintain the keyword and topic roadmap, prioritizing opportunities by traffic potential, competitive difficulty, and commercial value.

• Identify underperforming and high-potential URLs and convert that analysis into a prioritized, clearly briefed queue of work for editorial.

• Monitor rankings, impressions, CTR, and click share; diagnose movement and respond quickly to volatility, algorithm updates, and competitive shifts.

• Balance the mix of evergreen and timely coverage, protecting the compounding traffic base while capturing trending demand.

• Improve on-page and template-level SEO : titles, metadata, internal linking, structured data, and site architecture.

AI Overviews (AIO) Evaluation & Maximization

• Evaluate the brand’s presence across AI Overviews and other AI-generated search surfaces, and establish repeatable ways to measure inclusion and citation rates.

• Identify the query types and content patterns that earn AIO citations, and translate them into concrete, usable editorial guidance.

• Maximize inclusion through content structure, entity coverage, schema, answer formatting, and source credibility signals.

• Track the click and traffic impact of AIO across affected query sets, and adjust strategy where zero-click behaviour erodes performance.

• Stay ahead of developments across AI search surfaces and LLM assistants, and advise leadership on the implications for the brand.

Evergreen Content, Refresh & Republishing

• Develop a strong evergreen playbook: a documented, repeatable system covering how evergreen topics are selected, briefed, structured, published, updated, and measured - and drive its adoption across the editorial team.

• Grow and defend the evergreen content base - the durable, compounding library that drives the majority of recurring search clicks.

• Identify evergreen opportunities through demand and gap analysis, and brief them as long-lived assets built to rank and be cited for years.

• Define the evergreen standards and templates behind the playbook - depth, structure, entity coverage, internal linking, and update cadence - so quality is repeatable at scale.

• Pressure-test and evolve the playbook against results, keeping it current as search behaviour and AI surfaces shift.

• Identify republishing and refresh candidates through a data-driven model: traffic decay curves, ranking slippage, seasonality, SERP and AIO changes, and content gaps.

• Maintain a prioritized republishing pipeline with clear briefs so editorial knows exactly what to change and why.

• Define and enforce refresh standards, and measure post-republish lift to validate what actually works.

• Manage the content lifecycle end to end: refresh, consolidate, redirect, or prune.

• Maintain an update cadence for the evergreen library so top assets stay accurate, competitive, and AIO-eligible.

Analysis & Reporting

• Monitor KPIs across clicks, impressions, rankings, engagement, and revenue per article; provide clear reporting and actionable insight.

• Ensure tracking accuracy and data integrity across Search Console, analytics, and third-party rank and visibility tools.

• Run structured tests against search levers and turn what works into repeatable playbooks.

AI & Automation

Immotalente besetzt kaufmännische Stellen in Hausverwaltungen. Dahinter läuft ein selbstgebautes System: Kandidaten werden gefunden, bewertet und angeschrieben, über sechzehn Mandate hinweg. Dazu ein Wissensspeicher, in dem Mandate, Kunden und Abläufe liegen und aus dem heraus KI-Agenten arbeiten.

- 2-5 years of professional backend engineering experience building and operating production systems.

- Strong fundamentals in backend engineering: data structures, algorithms, concurrency, and writing code that's clear enough for the next person to change

title: Doctorant(e) - "Vers un bâtiment low-tech : caractériser et réduire les dépendances liées à la maintenance et à l'entretien du bâti face au changement climatique"
description:
Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne , c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable . Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain .
Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.
L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

Transitions numériques, écologiques, industrielles : les grands défis de notre époque sont aussi ceux de l’Institut Henri Fayol.
Ici se mêlent Informatique, Sciences des données, Management, Sciences humaines et sociales, Génie environnemental pour penser les systèmes complexes de demain : territoires, entreprises, filières industrielles.
📊 Résilience, performance, durabilité… Nous développons et expérimentons en lien étroit avec les acteurs socio-économique pour répondre aux exigences des transitions actuelles.
✨ Une recherche interdisciplinaire à fort impact, où l’humain est toujours au centre.

Cette thèse de doctorat sera rattachée au département Génie de l'Environnement pour les Organisations (GEO), membre du Laboratoire CNRS UMR 5600 Environnement Ville et Société (EVS). Pour répondre aux enjeux des transitions écologique, énergétique et industrielle, le département GEO accompagne les acteurs des territoires (acteurs publics et privés) vers une meilleure prise en compte des enjeux environnementaux et de résilience territoriale. Il s'attache ainsi à apporter des solutions nouvelles en matière d'analyse, de modélisation et d'évaluation environnementale des systèmes industriels et territoriaux dans un double contexte d'industrie des futurs et de villes et territoires soutenables.

🏠 Contexte

Présentation du sujet
Le changement climatique met en lumière, comme l'a fait auparavant la crise COVID, les vulnérabilités et liens de dépendance généralisée de nos modes de vie envers les infrastructures, les chaînes de valeur, et modes d'organisation économique et technique, éléments souvent déconnectés de l'usager final, de ses besoins et des conditions d'occupation. Pour le secteur du bâtiment, Cimerman (2023) évoque une tendance depuis plusieurs décennies de « simplification cartésienne » de la conception et de l'opération du bâti. Celle-ci se traduit notamment par le développement d'un imaginaire de « bâtiment-machine », se traduisant par une superposition d'éléments techniques complexes (chauffage, ventilation, climatisation), susceptibles d'être pilotés au travers d'outils informatiques et d'une gestion centralisée optimisée (Cimerman, 2023).
Face aux enjeux posés par le changement climatique, deux voies opposées d'adaptation du bâti se dessinent. La première, actuellement dominante, consiste à prolonger cet imaginaire de « bâtiment-machine », rationalisable, mesurable et optimisable, et ce notamment au travers du développement du « smart-building ». Cette approche technosolutionniste apporte des réponses clés-en-main (capteurs, outils de pilotage centralisés, etc.) aux gestionnaires et usagers de bâtiments. Néanmoins, elle présente certains défis pour leur maintenance et leur entretien. Nous pouvons citer le recours massif aux nouvelles technologies, coûteuses, complexes, rapidement obsolètes et dont la fabrication repose

description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At  Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. Team/ Role Paragraph:   

FinHub owns how money moves at Coinbase. Every dollar and token that enters, leaves, or moves within the company runs through this platform - fiat across ACH, wires, cards, RTP, and SEPA, crypto across dozens of blockchain networks, and internal movement across ledgers, legal entities, and customer accounts. As a Group Product Manager on the FinHub team within Platform , you'll own the systems that ensure every fund flow reaches a correct terminal state - the controls that stop unsafe movement, the detection that catches what slips through, and the remediation that recovers it. You'll set the reliability standard for money movement at Coinbase and lead through influence to hold the company to it.

What you’ll do: 

• Own the multi-year vision and strategy for money movement reliability and controls across fiat and crypto, defining per-rail service levels and resolution targets for every fund flow.

• Build the controls infrastructure governing money movement - determining which risk, compliance, and financial controls apply to each flow, verifying they ran, and confirming they passed before funds move.

• Drive real-time detection and end-to-end tracing across payment rails, blockchain networks, controls, and the ledger to identify and resolve failures fast.

• Scale correctness through AI agents that propose controls from product specs, triage alerts before an engineer opens them, and remediate within governed limits.

• Partner with Compliance, Risk, Finance, and every product group that moves money to establish control ownership and hold teams accountable for their fund flows.

Required Skills and Experience:

• 10+ years of product management experience, with deep expertise in money movement, payments infrastructure, ledgering, or financial platforms at scale.

• Track record owning strategy for large-scale money movement or financial systems - payment processing, transfers, ledgers, reconciliation, or the reliability layers around them.

• Deep technical fluency in distributed systems, event streaming, idempotency, double-entry ledgering, reconciliation, and the design of preventive and detective controls.

• Demonstrated ability to set standards that other teams must meet and make them stick across organizational boundaries in a highly regulated environment.

title: Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC) - Brockton, MA
description:
Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC) $70 K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

• Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.

• 401K with maximum employee matching.

• Health care benefits.

• Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.

• Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.

• Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

• Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.

• Customized schedules within available clinic hours.

• Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).

• Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.

• Incredible administrative support team.

• Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
